name: Summer at Inly
description_short: Summer day camp on the Inly School campus in Scituate, MA, offering full-day and extended-day camps, specialty camps and preschool programs for ages 3 to 14. Runs for ten weeks from mid-June to late August.
special_needs_notes: The site mentions an on-site nurse and an 'Allergy Aware' camp. A parent testimonial says nursing staff looked after a child's extra medical needs. No formal special-needs program is described.
